a multi-kilogram capacity, high temperature calorimeter for heterogeneous materials can be designed, constructed, and operated to provide reliable measurements of the entallpies of combustion of large samples of heterogeneous waste materials.

a calorimeter with a capacity of 3.5 kg of sample and an uncertainty of ± 1% has been designed, built, and tested.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design, construction and operation of a large capacity calorimeter for heterogeneous materials, and the application of this calorimeter to the determination of the enthalpies combustion of kilogram size samples of municipal solid wastes (MSW).
the development and testing of an apparatus and procedures for the accurate determination of the heat of combustion of kilo-gram quantities of municipal solid waste.
the development of a large capacity calorimeter to measure the enthalpies combustion of municipal solid wastes.

a multi-kilogram capacity calorimeter was constructed and tested to determine the entalpies of combustion of municipal solid waste samples.
